methodology_note: A targeted re-review (prompts/rereview.md) re-checked the reasoning of every flagged task wherever it depends on the simulated customer: which customer tools the task gives the simulator (user_tools), whether a customer call the script does not name is still the natural response to the script, how far the simulator guidelines apply, failures that need an agent error, what the agent can learn by asking the customer about her tool results, and whether comparisons with other tasks are like for like. Every changed verdict is backed by a replay on the v1.0.1 snapshot. Where this pass gives a verdict, it is the latest.
